---
title: "wgaim"
subtitle: "Whole Genome Average Interval Mapping for QTL Detection and Estimation using ASReml-R"
---

A computationally efficient whole genome approach to detecting and estimating significant QTL in linkage maps, using the linear mixed modelling functionality of ASReml-R.

**Authors:** Julian Taylor, Ari Verbyla

## Documentation

::: {.resource-list}
- [Vignette: Introduction to wgaim](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/wgaim/vignettes/wgaim_intro.html)
- [Reference manual (HTML)](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/wgaim/refman/wgaim.html)
- [Reference manual (PDF)](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/wgaim/wgaim.pdf)
- [CRAN page](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=wgaim)
- [Source code and issues on GitHub](https://github.com/DrJ001/wgaim)
:::

## Install

```r
install.packages("wgaim")
```

wgaim fits its models with ASReml-R, so you also need a licensed copy of [asreml](asreml.qmd).

## Cite

```r
citation("wgaim")
```
